**Job Description:**
 At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we've tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind. Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.
   

  

 We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders.
   

  

**About the Role:**
 As a Software Development Engineer on the Growth team, you'll build the systems that earn the trust of Remitly's high value senders. These are customers moving large transfers for real estate, education, long\-term investments, and other milestones that shape their financial futures across borders. This full\-stack role spans customer\-facing web and mobile experiences and deep partnership with foundational teams across identity and trust, money movement, pricing, and more. You'll partner with product, design, and engineering peers to define what it means to earn customer trust on their most consequential transfers — for customers sending more, with more on the line. You will report to the Engineering Manager for the team. This role is hybrid and based in Seattle, WA.
   

  

**You Will:**
* Build with the customer in mind by applying customer context and data to your technical decision\-making.
* Ship reliable, observable, and scalable features across the High Value Send experience — with depth in one area of the stack (web, mobile, or backend) and growing fluency across the others.
* Contribute to systems that meet availability and latency SLOs for the customer flows where trust matters most.
* Partner with product, design, data, and partner engineering teams — surfacing technical trade\-offs early to ship features for a diverse global customer base.
* Strengthen team culture through code review, design discussions, and mentoring SDE 1s and interns.


**You Have:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.
* 3\+ years of professional software development experience, with experience building features or components end\-to\-end and delivering production code on a team.
* Experience building customer\-facing experiences with TypeScript and React, or native mobile development (iOS/Android, React Native).
* Proficiency in one or more modern backend languages such as Java, Kotlin, Go, or Python, with a record of delivering production\-quality code.
* Experience contributing to distributed, large\-scale systems with a working understanding of service\-oriented architecture.
* Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, including familiarity with managed services.
* Bonus: Experience in FinTech, payments, or other regulated industries where reliability, security, and compliance shape engineering decisions.


**Compensation Details.** 
 The starting base salary range for this position is typically $144,000 \- $180,000\. In the U.S., Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. Your recruiter can share more information about medical benefits offered, as well as other financial benefits and total compensation components offered with this role.
   

  

**Our Benefits:**
* Flexible paid time off
* Health, dental, and vision \+ 401k plan with company matching
* Paid parental, medical, military and family care leave
* Mental Health \& Family Forming Benefits
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
* Continuing education benefits


**Our Connected Work Culture: Driving Innovation, Together**
 At Remitly, we believe that true innovation sparks when we come together. Our Connected Work Culture fosters dynamic in\-person collaboration, where ideas ignite and challenging problems find solutions faster. For corporate team members, we have an in\-office expectation of at least 50% of the time monthly, typically achieved by coming in three days a week. This creates a consistent, meaningful overlap that supports team norms and business needs. Managers also have the flexibility to set higher expectations based on their team's specific needs. These intentional in\-office moments are vital for deepening relationships, fueling creativity, and ensuring your impact is felt where it matters most.
